name: MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B
description: Table for stroring the Assignment Objects

columns.name: ASGN_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Primary Key to uniquely identify the row

columns.name: REF_ROW_GUID
columns.description: Reference key the to respective N/D row.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if Assignment Object has been published to Engine

columns.name: OWNER_MODULE
columns.description: Indicates the owning component of the Assignment Object

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Contains the id of the immediate parent

columns.name: PARENT_GUID1
columns.description: Contains the id of the top/primary assignment object

columns.name: PARENT_GUID2
columns.description: Contains the id of the great-great grand parent

columns.name: PARENT_GUID3
columns.description: Contains the id of the great grand parent

columns.name: PARENT_GUID4
columns.description: Contains the id of the grand parent

columns.name: PARENT_GUID5
columns.description: Contains the id of the immediate parent

columns.name: ASGN_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Language independent name of the Assignment Object

columns.name: APP_MODULE_NAME
columns.description: Contains the fully qualified java class name for the assignment object Application Module

columns.name: APP_MODULE_CONFIG_NAME
columns.description: Contains the the assignment object Application Module Config Name

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_DEFN
columns.description: Contains the fully qualified path of the view object

columns.name: FACT_ALIAS
columns.description: Contains the fact alias name that is stored in OBR

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_INSTANCE
columns.description: Contains the View Object instance name

columns.name: VIEW_CRITERIA_NAME
columns.description: Contains the view criteria name to be applied while executing the VO.

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_SCORE_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the attribute name to write back the score

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_IDENTIFIER_ATTR
columns.description: The name of the attribute on the work object that stores the unique/searchable (user visible) identifier

columns.name: ASGN_EXCL_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the name of the lock assignment attribute name in the primary VO, which is the attribute in the work object's VO that can be used to prevent assigning the certain row. This is applicable only for the Work Object

columns.name: ASGN_DATE_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the attribute name on the base VO for datetime to be stamped when the record is last assigned

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_ATTR1
columns.description: Name of the first attribute that makes up the object primary key

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_ATTR2
columns.description: Name of the second attribute that makes up the object primary key

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_ATTR3
columns.description: Name of the third attribute that makes up the object primary key

columns.name: CAND_OBJECT_REFRESH_INTERVAL
columns.description: Candidate Object Refresh Interval

columns.name: CAND_OBJECT_INITIAL_POOL_SIZE
columns.description: Candidate Object Initial Pool Size

columns.name: CAND_OBJECT_MAX_POOL_SIZE
columns.description: Candidate Object Maximum Pool Size

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the object is a Work object

columns.name: CANDIDATE_OBJECT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the object is a Candidate object

columns.name: INACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is active or not

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
